PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED:

2012-12-24 | 248 m MD | Namsang | cementing_issue | low | 2.3 hrs NPT
Cause: Excessive cement losses to formation while cementing across Namsang.
Remedy: Staged cement job with lightweight lead slurry and full tail string.

2012-12-24 | 529 m MD | Girujan | cementing_issue | low | 1.4 hrs NPT
Cause: Poor cement bond / losses during primary cementing of casing shoe in Girujan.
Remedy: Squeeze cemented shoe track, pressure tested to spec before drilling out.

2012-12-26 | 1638 m MD | Tipam | mud_loss | medium | 2.5 hrs NPT
Cause: Lost circulation 64 bbl/hr while drilling Tipam sand, partial returns only.
Remedy: Pumped 112 bbl LCM pill, reduced ROP, regained partial returns.

2012-12-26 | 1816 m MD | Barail | cementing_issue | low | 3.3 hrs NPT
Cause: Poor cement bond / losses during primary cementing of casing shoe in Barail.
Remedy: Squeeze cemented shoe track, pressure tested to spec before drilling out.

2012-12-27 | 2266 m MD | Barail | kick | high | 5.7 hrs NPT
Cause: Gas-cut mud and increasing pit volume observed drilling Barail, well flowing.
Remedy: Hard shut-in, recorded SIDPP/SICP, weighted up mud and circulated bottoms up.
